newsitem.title: JAPAN: Key JGBs record rise fueled by jump in T-bonds.
newsitem.headline: Key JGBs record rise fueled by jump in T-bonds.

text.p: Key December Japanese government bond futures rose to a high for any benchmark futures contract, and the key 182nd JGB yield fell to its lowest level ever in early morning trade on Wednesday.
Traders said JGBs were strong in the early morning as they carried over strong market sentiment from the previous day.
A trust bank trader said the surge in JGBs was fueled by a rise in U.S. Treasuries overnight.
"The market reacts to positive factors, which shows that market sentiment is strong," the trader said.
The December rose as high as 126.52 by 0045 GMT.
The yield of the benchmark 182nd JGB fell as low as 2.405 percent as of 0045 GMT.
